items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: Dr. Arnn — Larry — is just an incredible — I don’t know if you’ve met him but he’s a pretty incredible man.

ctx.x: All of a sudden they broke into a piece from an opera. They were singing opera. Not well but with such joy and verve that I said what a nice thing to hear in the dining hall.

Yeah sure, no I’m telling you. You know I was involved with the University of Washington for you know some years, and then compared to this? Well you’re involved with a university you know. It’s just a positive — everybody’s here because they want to be here. It’s not because Mommy and Daddy is sending them to school to learn how to drink beer. You know they’re here because they want to learn and they want to learn positive life values. And that comes from the leadership too, because the leadership of this school…
Yes indeed. Well thank you for your time, Fred, and you know what? I think you should become a professional musician. Best of luck with your future endeavors,
